def decide(bars, account):
    """Hold TSLA while close is above a 50-day average; wider exit buffer to avoid whipsaw, faster re-entry."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 50:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 50-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price >= average * 0.99:
            return "BUY", "close is near or above the 50-day average"
        return "HOLD", "waiting for an uptrend"
    if price < average * 0.92:
        return "SELL", "close fell well below the 50-day average"
    return "HOLD", "holding through the trend"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"
